newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Informatics ups stakes in associate firms.
newsitem.headline: Informatics ups stakes in associate firms.

text.p: Computer training company Informatics Holdings Ltd (IHL) said on Wednesday its had boosted its stakes in two associated businesses.

IHL said in separate statements it was lifting its stake in Singapore Informatics Computer Institute (Private) Ltd (SICI) to 85 percent from 19 percent and was taking an additional holding in IAF Pte Ltd (IAF).

Taking an additional 1.6 million shares of 10.00 rupees each (US$0.17) in Sri Lanka-registered SICI would make it an IHL subsidiary. The company said the deal would be funded by the capitalisation of a similar amount owing by SICI to IHL.

IHL also said it had subscribed for an additional 135,000 shares in IAF, which was issuing 450,000 new ordinary shares of S$1.00 in order to double its paid-up capital to S$900,000 and raise extra working capital.
Informatics said the IAF share purchase was funded from internal resources and was not expected to have an impact on earnings in the year.
